data.name: Altagracia
data.gender_notes: Altagracia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'altus' meaning 'high' and 'gratia' meaning 'grace'. The name Altagracia represents the exalted grace and divine favor bestowed upon someone. The name Altagracia carries the meaning “Exalted Grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Altagracia usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Altagracia total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: אלטגרסיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלטגרסיה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בספרדית ופירושו גבוה וקדוש. השם מורכב מ'אלטו' שפירושו גבוה ו'גראסיה' שפירושו חסד או קדושה. השם משקף את האמונה הנוצרית בקדושת האל והציפייה לחסדו.

in_greek.name: Αλταγκρασία
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει υψηλό και ιερό
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλταγκρασία είναι Χριστιανικό και προέρχεται από την Ισπανική γλώσσα. Σημαίνει υψηλό και ιερό, και είναι σύνθεση των λέξεων 'alto' που σημαίνει υψηλό και 'gracia' που σημαίνει χάρη ή ιερότητα. Το όνομα αντανακλά τη Χριστιανική πίστη στην ιερότητα του Θεού και την προσδοκία για τη χάρη Του.

in_latin.name: Altagracia
in_latin.meaning: Christian name meaning high and sacred
in_latin.long_meaning: Altagracia is a Christian name derived from Spanish, meaning high and sacred. It is composed of 'alto' meaning high and 'gracia' meaning grace or sacredness. The name reflects the Christian faith in the sacredness of God and the expectation of His grace.

in_english.name: Altagracia
in_english.meaning: A Christian name signifying high and sacred, derived from Spanish
in_english.long_meaning: Altagracia is a Christian name originating from Spanish, signifying high and sacred. It is a combination of 'alto' meaning high and 'gracia' meaning grace or sacredness. The name reflects the Christian faith in God's sacredness and the anticipation of His grace. Historically, the name has been used in various Christian cultures, symbolizing spiritual aspirations and devotion.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Altagracia, meaning “high grace,” is a name that embodies the Christian belief in God's abundant grace and goodness bestowed upon believers. It serves as a constant reminder of the divine favor and blessing that unfolds in the daily journey of the faithful.

historical_references.reference: Born in the Canary Islands in 1510, Altagracia de la Mar was a native Taíno princess who was captured by Spanish conquistadors. She was later baptized and given the Christian name Altagracia.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
